title: We should be more ambitious with the software we build
why_read: A opinion piece arguing for more ambitious software engineering sparked a very large discussion, suggesting it touches a nerve about industry complacency.
analysis: This appears to be an essay-style post urging engineers and companies to pursue more ambitious software projects rather than incremental or purely commercial work. Such pieces are more about industry culture and motivation than concrete technical content, so the value is in the discussion it provokes rather than new information. The high engagement indicates it resonated broadly, but the topic is subjective and not verifiable the way a technical benchmark would be.
